googleImagesAccess: Attempted; inaccessible through the available web tool.
method: Fallback image-search descriptions for common use cases, plus primary public recreation and extension sources; no reference pixels reused.
observations: Search examples often group seasonal action verbs, classroom craft activities, leaf chores and family outings. These are useful contexts, not evidence of keyword traffic volume.
Fall and autumn are synonyms, so the fall collection needs distinct compositions and activity-led subjects rather than recoloring the existing woodland and botanical artwork.
designDecisions: 44 independently composed color illustrations and 6 independently composed coloring outlines.
Prioritize clear human actions, coherent props, physically supported equipment and reusable school, garden, cooking and outdoor use cases.
No branded objects, readable invented text, copied stock poses or promises of organic traffic.
